<h2>Bo Shang, Ph.D.</h2>
<p><strong>Research Scientist | Robotics &amp; Multimodal Perception</strong><br>New York, NY</p>
<p><a href="mailto:bshang@umd.edu">bshang@umd.edu</a> &middot; <a href="tel:+19295200488">+1 (929) 520-0488</a> &middot; <a href="https://cnpcshangbo.github.io/">Website</a> &middot; <a href="https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=TVIPpDMAAAAJ&amp;hl=en">Google Scholar</a> &middot; <a href="https://orcid.org/0000-0002-5568-1566">ORCID</a></p>
<p>Robotics and AI researcher focused on reliable perception and field robotics for transportation and infrastructure. Combines multimodal sensing, computer vision, and experimental evaluation with working robotic systems. Research spans roadside LiDAR, vulnerable-road-user safety, robotic inspection, and vision-based UAV control.</p>

## Selected Research Experience

<p><strong>University of Maryland</strong> &middot; Jul 2026 - Present<br>Postdoctoral Associate, Civil and Environmental Engineering / Maryland Transportation Institute</p>
<ul>
  <li>Develop and integrate hardware and software for two sponsored transportation research projects under Professor Xianfeng Yang; support system testing, field data collection, and technical deliverables.</li>
  <li>Connect research requirements with working sensing systems through troubleshooting, documentation, and review of data quality.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>The City College of New York, CUNY</strong> &middot; Jul 2025 - Jun 2026<br>Postdoctoral Scholar, AI &amp; Mobility Research Lab</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed roadside LiDAR-camera research workflows covering capture, synchronization, calibration, reconstruction, annotation, and road-user detection for transportation safety.</li>
  <li>Investigated cross-configuration generalization and evaluated models across sites with different sensor beam counts, frame rates, and mounting geometries; published first-author work on LiDAR sensing and vulnerable-road-user detection.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>The City College of New York, CUNY</strong> &middot; Dec 2022 - Dec 2024<br>Postdoctoral Researcher, Robotics Lab</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed CNN-based structural-defect analysis and robotic inspection workflows linking sensing, cloud inference, 3D reconstruction, and engineering review.</li>
  <li>Built an iOS interface for a climbing inspection robot and integrated human review into inspection-data workflows; co-authored research in IEEE Transactions on Automation Science and Engineering.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Missouri University of Science and Technology</strong> &middot; Jan 2020 - Nov 2022<br>Postdoctoral Fellow</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed UAV guidance and clamping-robot components for bridge inspection, combining embedded perception, control, and system testing.</li>
  <li>Integrated ROS, NVIDIA Jetson, Raspberry Pi, and inter-robot communication; co-inventor on U.S. Patent 12,296,994 B2, granted in 2025.</li>
</ul>

## Selected Research

<p><strong>Reliable roadside perception</strong> &middot; Nov 2024 - Jun 2026</p>
<ul>
  <li>Investigated how reduced LiDAR beam coverage affects vulnerable-road-user detection, using comparative model evaluation to examine sensing limits.</li>
  <li>Developed a roadside safety-auditing framework linking trajectories, iterative human quality assurance, and near-miss analysis; a heavy-vehicle/bicycle case distinguished lateral intrusion from longitudinal collision risk.</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Vision-based control for field robotics</strong> &middot; 2015 - 2019</p>
<ul>
  <li>Developed and evaluated vision-based guidance and fractional-order control methods for quadrotor UAVs, including precision hovering with longer sampling periods; published first-author work in Nonlinear Dynamics.</li>
</ul>

## Technical Expertise

<p><strong>Research and evaluation</strong>: Cross-site evaluation, dataset and configuration versioning, annotation quality assurance, model evaluation, failure analysis, and reproducible research workflows.</p>

<p><strong>Robotics and sensing</strong>: LiDAR, RGB/RGB-D cameras, sensor synchronization and calibration, ROS / ROS 2, NVIDIA Jetson, embedded Linux, visual SLAM, and UAV perception and control.</p>

<p><strong>Software and machine learning</strong>: Python, C++, PyTorch, TensorFlow, OpenCV, AWS, Docker, Git; computer vision, 3D reconstruction, data pipelines, and cloud and edge inference.</p>
